title: Investments
calculation_pattern: Spending Total Euro or PERIODROLLING(Spending Total Euro,-2,0)
notes: Concetto coperto; il gap e' la resa MON/MQTR del modello PBI.

title: % Share of Investments
calculation_pattern: Spend / total spend in period * 100
notes: La misura esiste in PBI, ma OAS la usa anche a frame MON/MQTR.

title: Product Details
calculation_pattern: Product Details or PERIODROLLING(Product Details,-2,0)
notes: Coperta a livello concettuale.

title: % Share of Voice
calculation_pattern: Product Details / total product details in period * 100
notes: Coperta in PBI ma con semantica temporale diversa.

title: Investments by Promotional Interactions
calculation_pattern: Spend split by Digital/Traditional interaction group
notes: Serve packaging esplicito per canale/interazione.

title: % Share of Voice by Promotional Interactions Channels
normalized_title: % Share of Voice by Promotional Interactions Channels
calculation_pattern: SOV split by Digital/Traditional interaction group
notes: Non formalizzata come famiglia autonoma.

title: Selected Contact Metric
calculation_pattern: "Calls&Mentions"."@{var_mea}{Contact Number}"
notes: Il placeholder `@{var_mea}` suggerisce una famiglia dinamica non completamente tracciabile dal dump.

title: % of Selected Contact Metric
calculation_pattern: Selected contact metric / period total * 100
notes: Il modello PBI non espone una famiglia esplicita di share per questa batteria.

title: +/- vs PY - Selected Contact Metric
calculation_pattern: Selected contact metric - selected contact metric PY
notes: Richiesta chiaramente nei grafici OAS.

title: +/-% vs PY - Selected Contact Metric
calculation_pattern: (Selected contact metric / selected contact metric PY - 1) * 100
notes: Non formalizzata nel semantic model corrente.

title: Prescription Spend Absolute
calculation_pattern: @{var_mea_pre}{Spending Total Euro} / 1000 by current/future prescribing
notes: Derivabile da Promo Spend con filtri su Current/Future Prescribing.

title: Prescription Spend %
calculation_pattern: Spend by prescribing segment / month total * 100
notes: Richiede misure/pagine dedicate ma non nuova base dati.

title: Contact Number
calculation_pattern: Contact Number or PERIODROLLING(Contact Number,-2,0)
notes: Il concetto esiste, il frame MON/MQTR no.

title: Share of Contact Number
calculation_pattern: Contact Number / total contact number in period * 100
notes: Manca una famiglia esplicita di denominatori/quote contatti.

title: Contact Number with intention to increase Rx
normalized_title: Contact Number with intention to increase Rx
calculation_pattern: FILTER(Contact Number USING Future Prescribing = INCREASE)
notes: Concetto presente ma con naming diverso.

title: % of Contact Number with intention to increase Rx
normalized_title: % of Contact Number with intention to increase Rx
calculation_pattern: Filtered Contact Number / total contacts * 100
notes: Non formalizzata come misura autonoma.

title: Product Details with Positive Prescribing
calculation_pattern: Positive prescribing filter on Product Details
notes: Molto vicino alla misura PBI esistente.

title: Contacts with Positive Prescribing
calculation_pattern: Positive prescribing filter on Contact Number
notes: Molto vicino alla misura PBI esistente.

title: Conversion rate - % of Calls converted in intention to prescribe
normalized_title: Conversion rate - % of Calls converted in intention to prescribe
calculation_pattern: Positive prescribing calls / Product Details * 100
notes: Coperta nel modello attuale.

title: Conversion rate - % of Contacts converted in intention to prescribe
normalized_title: Conversion rate - % of Contacts converted in intention to prescribe
calculation_pattern: Positive prescribing contacts / Contact Number * 100
notes: Coperta nel modello attuale.

title: Weighted Calls
calculation_pattern: "Calls&Mentions"."@{measure}{WCalls}" or PERIODROLLING(...,-2,0)
notes: Base disponibile, ma OAS la usa in una batteria dinamica piu ampia.

title: SOV% on Weighted Calls
calculation_pattern: Menarini filtered WCalls / market WCalls * 100
notes: Non esiste una misura esplicita SOV su Weighted Calls.

title: +/-% on Weighted Calls vs PY
calculation_pattern: Growth % on WCalls and MQTR WCalls
notes: Mancano le varianti comparative.

title: Index family
calculation_pattern: Corporation share / market share * 100
notes: Famiglia analitica OAS avanzata non presente nel modello PBI.

title: % Corp on total / % Market on total
normalized_title: % Corp on total / % Market on total
calculation_pattern: Corp share on total and market share on total
notes: Necessaria per i report index / ranking OAS.
